performance.verdict: Efficiency real, but volume too thin and pipeline silent — prove-it month at risk.

findings.text: Phone-match attribution gap (due 8/7) and sync/contact cleanup (due 8/14) both unresolved — every lead-to-patient trace is unreliable until fixed.
CPL improved 17.78% but spend dropped 28.74%, compressing to $25.62/day — volume fell 13.33%; efficiency gain is real but insufficient at this rate.
3-day signal (8/23–8/25): leads 6+8+3=17 vs prior 3 days (8/20–8/22): 4+0+5=9 — a real short-term uptick, but spend also rose from ~$22 to ~$32/day driving it.
GHL shows 93 opportunities created but 0 won, 0 appointments, $0 pipeline value in 28 days — leads are arriving but nothing converts inside CRM; intake leak, not an ads problem.
Google Ads spend is $0 across all 28 days; SOW and 7/19 call directed budget shift mainly to Google/LSA — this channel is dark and contradicts the agreed architecture.

suggestions.text: Escalate phone-match attribution and sync cleanup as prove-it blockers; both overdue by 12–19 days.
suggestions.monday_update: Phone-match attribution (due 8/7) and contact/sync cleanup (due 8/14) are both overdue and unresolved. Without these, the lead-to-patient trail the client is scoring August on — their explicit scoreboard — cannot be verified. Ahmed/Ali to confirm completion or revised ETA by 8/28. Success check: attribution gap closed and sync audit passing by 8/29.

suggestions.text: Investigate GHL intake: 93 opps created, 0 won, 0 appointments — confirm whether Lily/new hire is working pipeline or leads are stalling unworked.
suggestions.monday_update: 28-day GHL data shows 93 opportunities created with 0 won and 0 appointments logged — this is an intake process gap, not an ads issue. Sohib to confirm with Lily and the new intake hire whether contacts are being called/followed up within the agreed window. Success check: at least some opportunities move to 'appointment booked' stage by next biweekly Lily sync (target 8/29).

suggestions.text: Watch whether 3-day lead uptick (17 leads vs 9 prior 3 days) holds at current ~$32/day spend before any budget move.
suggestions.monday_update: Leads jumped to 17 over 8/23–8/25 vs 9 the prior three days, with spend rising from ~$22 to ~$32/day — causation likely but not yet confirmed. Do not scale until this rate holds for a full 3-day window at stable spend. Re-check 8/29: if CPL stays below $12 and leads ≥5/day, bring a scale recommendation to Sohib.
